# AI Outputs

This document contains the AI-generated outputs used during the development of the ABC Corp Workflow Management System. The AI model generated the system architecture, backend implementation, frontend structure, workflow builder logic, authentication system, and role-based access control.

The generated output served as the base implementation for the final application.



# Full Stack Architecture Generated by AI

The AI generated a full-stack web application using the following technology stack.

Frontend:
React  
Vite  
Tailwind CSS  
React Flow  
Zustand  
Axios  

Backend:
Node.js  
Express.js  
SQLite Database  
JWT Authentication  
bcrypt password hashing  

Architecture pattern:
REST API + Role Based Access Control.

# Backend Implementation Generated by AI

The AI generated a Node.js Express backend that supports the required business functionality.

Dependencies used:

bcrypt  
cors  
express  
jsonwebtoken  
sqlite3  

Example generated server entry file:

```javascript
const express = require("express")
const cors = require("cors")

require("./database")

const authRoutes = require("./routes/auth")
const clientRoutes = require("./routes/clients")
const projectRoutes = require("./routes/projects")
const vendorRoutes = require("./routes/vendors")
const traineeRoutes = require("./routes/trainees")
const workflowRoutes = require("./routes/workflows")

const app = express()

app.use(cors())
app.use(express.json())

app.use("/auth", authRoutes)
app.use("/clients", clientRoutes)
app.use("/projects", projectRoutes)
app.use("/vendors", vendorRoutes)
app.use("/trainees", traineeRoutes)
app.use("/workflows", workflowRoutes)

app.listen(5000, () => {
console.log("Server running on 5000")
})


#Database Schema Generated by AI

The AI generated the SQLite schema required for the application.

Tables created:

users
clients
client_contacts
projects
vendors
trainees
trainings

Example generated schema:

db.run(`
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
email TEXT,
password TEXT,
role TEXT
)
`)
Additional tables manage clients, projects, vendors, trainees and training assignments.

# Role Based Access Control Generated by AI

The AI generated RBAC functionality supporting two roles.

Roles:

Client
Account Manager

Client permissions:

view projects
view trainees
view workflow progress

Account Manager permissions:

create clients
create projects
assign vendors
manage trainees
configure workflows

Role validation is performed using backend middleware and frontend route protection.

# React Frontend Generated by AI

The AI generated the React frontend using React + Vite + Tailwind CSS.

Generated pages:

Login
Dashboard
Clients
Projects
ProjectDetail
Vendors
Trainees
WorkflowBuilder

These pages allow users to manage clients, projects, vendors, trainees and workflows.

# Workflow Builder Generated by AI

The AI generated a drag and drop workflow builder using React Flow.

Features generated:

Node palette
Drag and drop nodes
Node connections
Workflow canvas
Workflow JSON saving

Node types supported:

Training
VendorAssignment
Certification
Interview
OfferLetter
Hiring
Decision

Example workflow JSON:

{
  "nodes": [
    {
      "id": "node_1",
      "data": { "label": "Training" }
    }
  ],
  "edges": []
}

Each workflow can be configured per project and stored in the database.

# Zustand State Management Generated by AI

The AI generated a Zustand store to manage application state.

State managed:

authentication
user role
workflow nodes
workflow edges

Example generated store:

export const useWorkflowStore = create((set)=>({
nodes:[],
edges:[],
setNodes:(nodes)=>set({nodes}),
setEdges:(edges)=>set({edges})
}))


# Axios API Integration Generated by AI

The AI generated Axios configuration for connecting the frontend to the backend API.

Example configuration:

const api = axios.create({
baseURL:"http://localhost:5000"
})

Axios interceptors were also used to attach authentication tokens to API requests.

Summary

The AI generated the base system architecture, backend APIs, database schema, authentication system, frontend structure, workflow builder implementation, and state management.
